plan: My private value is $24. In a second-price sealed bid auction, the optimal strategy is typically to bid your true value. If I bid less than $24, I risk losing the item even when winning would be profitable. If I bid more, I might pay more than the item is worth to me. The worst-case scenario is paying close to my value and not gaining profit. Therefore, I'll bid my true value of $24, which maximizes my potential profit across potential opponent bid scenarios.
